# Runique

> Rust web framework inspired by Django, built on Axum, SeaORM and Tera.
> Type-safe forms, auto-generated admin, CSRF/CSP middleware, persistent sessions.

Runique is open-source and available on crates.io. This site is a live demo.

## Documentation

- [Documentation (EN)](https://runique.io/docs/en): Full English documentation
- [Documentation (FR)](https://runique.io/docs/fr): Documentation complete en francais
- [Changelog](https://runique.io/changelog): Version history and release notes
- [Comparison](https://runique.io/comparatif): Runique next to Loco, Cot and Django, known limits, what's coming

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/seb-alliot/runique): Source code
- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/runique): Rust package

## Demo

- [Live demo](https://runique.io): Forms, admin, auth, ORM, middlewares
- [llms-full.txt](https://runique.io/llms-full.txt): Full content for LLMs
